name: hybrid_request_probe_v1
purpose: Diagnose initial hybrid rollout text anomaly with a no-update backend/sampling contrast. Not a second PPO batch or a new skill qualification.
source_model: Existing pinned b0 weights, no PPO checkpoint or model download
requests: Eight fixed initial FrozenLake boards1..8; same official prompt, max1 turn, max512 tokens; temperature0 and1. Transport seeds101..108 map to actual1..8 in the diagnostic-only loop.
hybrid: Initialize original two-GPU actor/critic/FSDP+native SGLang hybrid configuration, then one validation dispatch of16 requests after the first weight wake/sync. Custom trainer fit has no update or save code. Skill system disabled solely to isolate initial action generation.
standalone: After owned hybrid cluster cleanup, one native SGLang engine on GPU3 replays the16 captured prompt-ID and lossless PNG requests with identical sampling parameters. No prompt/processor regeneration.
measurements: all raw input IDs and output IDs
greedy exact token agreement and common prefix length
output token length and action-format presence
raw text retained for qualitative anomaly review
interpretation: Greedy disagreement identifies a backend/weight/input-processing difference, not automatically a weight-sync bug. Agreement across8 inputs reduces but cannot eliminate that concern. Sampled text is descriptive, not RNG-identical across concurrent replicas and sequential standalone replay. No confidence/performance/generalization claims.
stop: Exactly16 hybrid+16 standalone requests maximum. No seed replacement, no training/backward, no skill admission, no new checkpoint/export. Preserve failures. Any retry retains the first receipt deadline and cannot duplicate completed requests.
